user.title: Automate Pulse PRO
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Pulse PRO hub. Add your blinds in the Automate app first. Tip: give the hub a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) in your router so it doesn't change.

data_description.port: The Pulse PRO local control port is 1487.

reconfigure.title: Change hub address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or port of your Pulse PRO hub. Your blinds, entities and settings are kept.

data_description.port: The Pulse PRO local control port is 1487.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the hub. Check the IP address and port, and that the hub is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The hub address has been updated.

init.title: Pulse PRO options
init.description: Blinds found on the hub so far: {blinds}

data_description.extra_blinds: 3-character IDs separated by commas, for blinds that discovery missed (e.g. asleep or out of range).
data_description.excluded_blinds: 3-character IDs separated by commas, for devices you don't want in Home Assistant.
data_description.position_interval: How often each blind is asked for its position. Positions are also re-checked automatically after every command.
data_description.invert_position: Turn this on if the position is the wrong way round (a fully open blind shows 0 % instead of 100 %).
data_description.battery_min_voltage: Leave both at 0 to detect 12 V or 8.4 V packs automatically. The 'Battery Voltage' diagnostic sensor shows what your blinds report.
data_description.battery_max_voltage: Must be higher than the empty voltage.

error.invalid_blind_id: Blind IDs are 3 letters or numbers, separated by commas (e.g. ABC, X1Y).
error.invalid_voltage_range: Set both voltages (empty lower than full), or set both to 0 for automatic.
